title: Friday Squid Blogging: Truckload of Squid Spills in Rhode Island
content_md: Ugh : A tractor-trailer rollover sent a truckload of squid spilling into a Rhode Island roadway, leaving a stench as they sat in the road for hours in the summer heat. Local authorities have dubbed it the “Squidpocalypse of ’26.” That would be twenty tons of squid. As usual, you can also use this squid post to talk about the security stories in the news that I haven’t covered. Blog moderation policy.
exclude_reason: Bruce Schneier's Friday Squid Blogging: fun filler post about a squid spill in Rhode Island. Not a security event.
